shell.title: AgroFarm
shell.tagline: Decision support for crop growth and rotation planning.
shell.disclaimer: This tool supports farmers and local experts. It never replaces local agronomic judgment.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: This page could not be shown. Reload the page to try again.

landing.title: See how weather and El Nino could change your crops
landing.intro: AgroFarm compares crop rotations under different rainfall, temperature and El Nino conditions. It gives ranges, not promises.
landing.demoNote: The demo uses example data for a pilot farm near Guatemala City. You do not need an account.

demo.disabled: Demo mode is turned off on this server. Try again later or ask the team for access.
demo.rateLimited: Too many demo requests from your network. Wait a minute and try again.
demo.full: The demo is full right now (at capacity). Try again in a few minutes.
demo.failed: The demo could not be started. Try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while loading this. Try again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your demo session expired. Start the demo again from the start page.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

farm.noRotation: No rotation recorded for this farm yet.

climate.title: Climate history
climate.intro: Monthly rainfall and temperature near the farm. Pick the months you want to look at.
climate.empty: No climate data is available for this location yet.

chart.title: Monthly rainfall and temperature, {{start}} to {{end}}
chart.description: Bars show rainfall in mm per month, from {{rainMin}} to {{rainMax}}. Lines show mean, minimum and maximum temperature in °C, from {{tempMin}} to {{tempMax}}.
chart.gaps_one: {{count}} month has no data and is left blank.
chart.gaps_other: {{count}} months have no data and are left blank.

missing.title: Months with no data
missing.none: Every month in this range has data.

enso.title: El Nino and La Nina phases
enso.intro: El Nino and La Nina change rainfall patterns in Central America. Each box is one month of the range above.
enso.listLabel: El Nino and La Nina phase by month
enso.source: Source: {{source}}. A month counts as El Nino when the ocean temperature index is {{threshold}} °C or higher, and as La Nina at minus {{threshold}} °C or lower.

scenario.title: What if the weather changes?
scenario.intro: Move the sliders to try a different season. The result is a range, because nobody can predict a season exactly.
scenario.enso: ENSO phase (El Nino or La Nina)
scenario.noCrops: No crops recorded for this farm yet, so a crop simulation is not possible.

simulation.outOfRange: Some inputs are outside the range the model was trained on, so read this result with extra care:

target.yield_anomaly_pct: change in yield compared with a normal year

feature.enso_roni_lag3: El Nino or La Nina, 3 months earlier

chart.title: Baseline and scenario compared
chart.row: {{name}}: likely range from {{low}} to {{high}}, middle estimate {{mid}}.
chart.help: The coloured band is the likely range (10th to 90th percentile). The dark mark is the middle estimate (50th percentile). Zero means no change.

attributions.title: What drives the change
attributions.help: Each line shows how much one input moves the middle estimate. Minus lowers it, plus raises it.

provenance.title: Where these numbers come from
provenance.stubNotice: The numbers shown here come from fixed rules, not from a trained model. They show how the tool will work and must not be used for decisions.

rotations.title: Compare rotation strategies
rotations.intro: Each strategy is scored for the priorities set for this farm, under the scenario above. Read the gaps and risks before you decide.
rotations.empty: No rotation strategies are available for this farm yet.
rotations.order: Strategies are listed from the highest score to the lowest. A higher score does not mean a strategy is right for your farm: check each one with a local expert.
rotations.omitted_one: {{count}} strategy was left out because it is missing reasons, evidence, benefits, gaps or risks.
rotations.omitted_other: {{count}} strategies were left out because they are missing reasons, evidence, benefits, gaps or risks.
rotations.fewerThanThree: Fewer than three strategies could be compared, so this comparison is incomplete.
rotations.topScore: Highest score for the priorities you set

uploads.title: Upload your farm data
uploads.intro: Send a CSV or GeoJSON file with your parcels and seasons. The server checks it and stores the rows that pass.
uploads.notice: Uploaded data is checked and stored, but it is not used yet. Recommendations, scenarios and model results do not change because of it. This tool supports decisions and does not replace local agronomic judgment.

template.heading: Get the template
template.body: The template is a CSV file with one column for each field the server reads. A cell left empty means the value is not known. It is never read as zero.
template.examples: The template has two example rows. Replace the example values with your own data.
template.columns: Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Numbers use a decimal point. Units: area in ha, yield in kg/ha, rainfall in mm, soil nutrients in mg/kg, organic matter in %.

choose.heading: Choose your file
choose.label: File to upload
choose.hint: CSV (.csv) or GeoJSON (.geojson or .json), up to 2 MB, UTF-8 text.
choose.cannotSend: This file cannot be sent. {{count}} problem(s) stop the whole file.

fileProblem.type: Only .csv and .geojson files can be uploaded (.json is read as GeoJSON).
fileProblem.size: This file is too large ({{size}}). The limit is 2 MB.
fileProblem.encoding: This file is not valid UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and try again.
fileProblem.read: This file could not be read. Try choosing it again.

review.heading: Check your file
review.rowsRead_one: {{count}} row read: {{valid}} without problems, {{invalid}} with problems.
review.rowsRead_other: {{count}} rows read: {{valid}} without problems, {{invalid}} with problems.
review.clientNote: This check runs in your browser. The server checks the file again and its answer is the one that counts. Rows with problems are not stored.
review.previewHint: Row 1 is the first row below the header. Empty cells are shown as empty and are not read as zero.
review.noneSendable: No row passed the check, so there is nothing to send.

rule.parcel_id: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
rule.integer: Use a whole number, for example 2025.
rule.date_invalid: This date does not exist in the calendar.
rule.harvest_before_sowing: The harvest date cannot be before the sowing date.
rule.number: Use a number with a decimal point, for example 2.5.
rule.min: Use a number of at least {{min}}.
rule.max: Use a number of at most {{max}}.
rule.irrigation: Use one of: {{values}}. Or leave it empty.
rule.extra_cells: This row has more cells than the header has columns ({{expected}}). A comma inside text needs quotes.
rule.geometry: The shape must be a closed Polygon or MultiPolygon in longitude, latitude order.
rule.no_rows: The file has no data rows.
rule.unterminated_quote: A quoted cell is never closed.
rule.bad_json: The file is not valid JSON.
rule.features_not_list: The features entry must be a list.
rule.not_feature: This item is not a GeoJSON Feature.

sending.heading: Sending
sending.status: Sending {{name}} ({{size}}). Waiting for the server to check it...
sending.note: The browser does not report how much of the file has left, so this bar does not show a percentage.

error.tooLarge: The server says this file is too large. The limit is 2 MB.
error.rejected: The server did not accept this file: {{message}}
error.maybeStored: The server may have received the file before the connection failed. Check with the team before you send it again.
error.retry: You can send the file again.

result.leadAccepted: The server checked the file and stored every row.
result.leadPartial: The server stored the rows that passed its checks. The rows with problems listed below were left out.
result.leadRejected: No rows were stored. Fix the problems listed below and upload the file again.
result.kept: The server keeps a record of this upload and a copy of the original file.
result.notUsed: Uploaded data is not used yet. Recommendations, scenarios and model results do not change because of this upload.
